72:1: Say: It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened and said: We have heard an astonishing Quran.
72:2: It guides to the right, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anything with our Rabb.
72:3: And undoubtedly, the majesty of our Rabb is very exalted; He has taken neither a spouse nor a child.
72:4: And surely he, our foolish one, was saying an excessive word against Allah.
72:5: And we thought that humans and jinn would never tell a lie about Allah.
72:6: And undoubtedly, some men from among humans used to seek refuge in some men from among jinn, and this increased their transgression.
72:7: And undoubtedly, they thought, just as you thought, that Allah would never resurrect anyone.
72:8: And undoubtedly, we touched the heaven and found it filled with severe guards and flames.
72:9: And we used to sit in sitting places to hear from it, but now whoever attempts to listen finds a flame watching for him.
72:10: And we do not know whether evil was intended for those on the earth, or whether their Rabb willed right guidance for them.
72:11: And undoubtedly, of us there are those who are righteous, and of us there are those below that; we are diverse paths.
72:12: And we realized that we can never render Allah helpless on the earth, nor can we ever render Him helpless by fleeing.
72:13: And undoubtedly, when we heard the guidance, we believed in it; so whoever believes in his Rabb, he fears neither loss nor hardship.
72:14: And undoubtedly, of us there are Muslims, and of us there are those who deviate from the truth. Whoever becomes a Muslim, it is they who have sought the right way.
72:15: As for those who deviate, they have become firewood for Hell.
72:16: And if they had remained upright on the path, We would surely have given them abundant water to drink.
72:17: So that We may test them with it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Rabb, He will drive him into a severe punishment.
72:18: And undoubtedly, the masjids belong to Allah; so do not supplicate to anyone along with Allah.
72:19: And truly, when the servant of Allah stood up to supplicate to Him, they almost crowded over him.
72:20: Say: I only supplicate to my Rabb, and I do not associate anyone with Him.
72:21: Say: Undoubtedly, I possess for you neither harm nor benefit.
72:22: Say: Undoubtedly, no one can ever rescue me from Allah, and I can never find any refuge other than Him.
72:23: Except for a conveyance from Allah and His messages. And whoever disobeys Allah and His messenger, undoubtedly for him is the fire of Hell, in which they will abide forever.
72:24: Until when they see that which they are promised, they will know whose helper is weaker and fewer in number.
72:25: Say: I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Rabb will make a long period for it.
72:26: He is the Knower of the unseen; He does not disclose His unseen to anyone.
72:27: Except a messenger whom He approves; undoubtedly He makes observers walk in front of him and behind him.
72:28: So that He may know that they have delivered the messages of their Rabb. He has encompassed what is with them and counted everything in number.
